title: ジャパンカップにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the great autumn race, the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio feels like she's grown after all the hardships she's gone through.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is her big day. She heads toward the track filled with energy and drive.
